title: AR151  Goat's Head in Profile
medium: O.P. white earthenware clay, decoration in engobes under partial brushed glaze, painted ground

said.q: A strong sense of contrast is apparent in this work, as white, black, and blue hues complement each other, causing the image of the goat to clearly stand out. Picasso's skill at capturing the expression of his subject shines through, even in his animal subjects, as we sense a mischievous twinkle in this goat's wide open eye.
